title: Metropolitan Life Insurance Company Tower
visualBrief: The restored1909 campanile: subtly narrowing limestone/marble shaft with triple windows, four decorated mosaic clocks, five open arches on each gallery, dormered lattice pyramid, bronze bells, octagonal cupola and gilded lantern.

sourceFacts.modernization: Morgan & Meroni,1960–1964; original proportions and entasis retained
sourceFacts.dials: White and turquoise vitreous mosaic; copper-edged numerals and glazed minute marks
sourceFacts.arcade: Five arches per elevation; three-story openings around a smaller setback core
sourceFacts.domeRestoration: BCA documents23.75karat Italian gold-leaf gilding during the2001 exterior restoration

reconstruction.facade: Published85×75ft rectangular foot and slight entasis replace a mistaken full-block envelope. Three groups of three windows, alternate projecting sills, paired clock-level windows, modern simplified stone and lower granite water table follow LPC plates.
reconstruction.clocks: Four white/turquoise dials retain modeled Arabic flat ribbon numerals, fixed10:10 hands, minute discs and folded wreath/fruit/scroll motifs. Curved ribbon joins and sculpted fruits remain reconstructions, not scans.
reconstruction.capital: Actual openings through the five-arch masonry screens reveal a separately windowed inner core. Open balustrades, the smaller four-story plinth and slender cornices reproduce the restored planar profile.
reconstruction.crown: Major original crown parts and unequal bells remain; raised0.068m roof lattice and thin dome seams are intentionally omitted in the reviewed medium-fi source.

limitations: The unchanged original buildMetropolitan recipe reproduces289882triangles/27024756bytes exactly. Reviewed source keeps the original narrowing85x75ft shaft, all major floor/window datums, four8.0772m dials, paired clock-level windows, genuinely open five-arch galleries around an inset windowed core, raised balustraded setbacks,34pyramidal roof dormers, octagonal cupola with four unequal bronze bells, eight dome dormers, upper platform, glazed lantern and213.36m tip. Source retains twelve Arabic numbers,60minute discs, original fixed10:10 hands, raised folded wreath leaves/fruit and stylized corner shell/dolphin scrolls. Clock strokes become flat ribbons; original0.068m raised roof lattice and thin gold dome seams fall below medium-fi extent thresholds and are omitted. Door/facade/grille/tiny ornament dimensions and all intermediate crown stage elevations remain original photo reconstructions; only overall base/height/dial dimensions and major counts are primary measurements. Skyline keeps four white/turquoise clocks and hands,20front-facing arched apertures, true inner core/setbacks and coarse open cupola, dome/lantern mass; it omits window subdivisions, gallery back faces/intrados, bell hardware, dormers and tiny guards. District groups each window triplet into one pane, samples six-floor datums, retains sparse arch intrados, flat arched dormer panes and fuller crown stages but omits bells and numerals. Street restores independent window/floor cadence, Arabic numerals, folded sampled wreath and all four bells with denser dormers/balustrades, omitting bronze numeral outline, minute discs and fruit. Close-up restores fine clock ornament, frames and crown sampling. Shared limestone approximates varied original marble/limestone; tinted painted-metal graph approximates bronze and gold-colored dome. All near levels use four draw groups with no embedded images. Real OneMadison office wing, street surroundings and interiors are excluded. Physical-device/dense-city timing and surveyed entrance/curb fit are not claimed.
